final: WITH f AS (SELECT account_id, amount, balance, type FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400), per_acct AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM f GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed), AVG(avg_bal) FROM per_acct
